fields.hero_description: Build a makeup consultation form that asks about the skin and the look before the event, then saves every booking for you.
fields.features_heading: What the Artist Knows Before the Brush Is Out
fields.features_subheading: Describe your services and Emergent builds the form, the booking table behind it, and the emails that go out after a client answers.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the service

Choose bridal and the form asks for the ceremony time and how many people need makeup. Choose a lesson and it asks which look the client wants to learn and what they own.
fields.feature_2:
Inspiration photos inside the booking

Clients add photos of looks they like while they answer. The photos stay with the booking. The artist opens them next to the skin notes and never has to search old texts.
fields.feature_3:
A reaction question that pauses a booking

Ask whether the client has ever reacted to a product. A yes holds the booking as Needs review, and the artist reads that answer in the app before confirming the time.
fields.feature_4:
Emails that move each booking along

Email the artist when a new booking is ready for review. In a group booking, the app emails a reminder to each person who still has not answered 2 days before the event.
fields.feature_5:
Every booking in a table you own

Answers land in a database you own, with no response caps. Filter by event date to see next month's weddings, or by service to plan the lesson calendar for the season.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can take with you

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository. Keep building on it there when the booking form has to sit inside a larger studio website you already run.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Bookings and What the Answers Change
fields.tab_content_1:
By September 5, Amaya has her trial with Liesel

Amaya Szabolcs is getting married on October 17 and books Liesel Ruskova for the day. She answers with a 3 pm outdoor ceremony, 4 people getting makeup, dry skin, and 3 inspiration photos. The form sets her trial for September 5, 6 weeks before the wedding, and saves the booking with every answer.
fields.tab_content_2:
The 6 products in Thea's bag shape her lesson

Thea Haddington wears makeup to work every weekday and wants a look she can finish in 10 minutes. She books a 90-minute lesson at Gilmartin Makeup Studio and lists the 6 products she already owns. The app emails Corin Gilmartin the booking, and he plans the lesson around those 6 products instead of a new kit.
fields.tab_content_3:
Lash glue reactions wait on Hester, who reviews each

Pellicano Beauty Bar asks one question before any eye look: has a product ever caused a reaction? Ysolde Farquhar answers yes and names lash glue. The app holds her booking as Needs review and emails lead artist Hester Quarrie that a booking is ready for review. Hester reads it in the app before she confirms.
fields.tab_content_4:
On June 10, 3 of the 14 staff still owe answers

Talbridge Architects is updating its staff photos, and Rafe Haldane is doing makeup for the June 12 headshot day. The 14 staff answer one short form about skin type, glasses, and the finish they want. By June 10, 11 of 14 have answered, and the app emails the other 3 a reminder, 2 days before the shoot.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Makeup Consultation Form
fields.howto_description: Follow 7 steps to set up a makeup consultation form that fits each service and puts every answer in front of the artist.
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Tie the dates to the event
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down the services you book, such as bridal parties, lessons, and headshot days. Each one becomes a choice at the top of the form with its own questions. A lesson client never sees a question about a ceremony time.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask about skin type and the finish the client wants. Add a question on whether any product has caused a reaction, and decide what a yes does to the booking before the first client answers it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Add a photo field for inspiration looks and cap it at 3, a number the artist can compare at a glance. Put it after the skin questions, once the client has thought about their own skin.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Count the bridal trial back from the wedding, such as 6 weeks before. For group bookings, pick the day reminders go out. The last answers then arrive before the event, not on the morning of it.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Describe the form to Emergent in plain English, with every service and its questions in one prompt. Emergent builds the form, the database behind it, and a screen where the artist reads each booking.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Name the artist who takes each service and how they hear about new bookings. Keep the email to a short note and leave the answers in the app, where the artist reads them before confirming.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book a test consultation as a made-up bride with a wedding 2 months out. Check that the trial date follows your rule and that the booking shows in the table with its photos.

faq_plan.q: What is a makeup consultation form?
faq_plan.a: A makeup consultation form is the set of questions a makeup artist asks before an appointment. It covers the event and its timing, the client's skin type, the look they want, and any product that has caused a reaction. The artist reads the answers before the first brush touches the client's face.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a makeup consultation form?
faq_plan.a: List the services you offer, the questions each one needs, and what should happen once a client answers. Put all of it in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the form and a database you own for every booking, and the free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What questions should a bridal makeup consultation form ask?
faq_plan.a: Start with the wedding date, the ceremony time, and whether the ceremony is indoors or outdoors. Then ask how many people need makeup, the bride's skin type, and the look she wants, with room for photos. Add the venue address and a time to be ready by, and count back from it to plan the start.

faq_plan.q: Can a makeup consultation form be used for microblading?
faq_plan.a: It can book the appointment, but keep the procedure paperwork separate. Use the consultation form for the client's brow goals and photos. Then send a permanent makeup consent form before the visit, with wording you have checked with your own advisor.

faq_plan.q: Should a makeup consultation form ask about allergies?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Ask whether any product has ever caused a reaction, and which one, in plain words a client can answer. Decide in advance what a yes does, such as holding the booking until the artist has read it. Emergent builds the form so that answer is kept in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How do clients add inspiration photos to a makeup consultation form?
faq_plan.a: They upload them in a photo field while they answer, from a phone or a laptop. Set a limit, such as 3 photos, and ask for one line on what they like in each. The photos stay attached to the booking, next to the skin answers the artist reads.

faq_plan.q: Can a makeup consultation form cover a studio's tattoo clients too?
faq_plan.a: Not well. Give tattoo clients their own form. Keep the makeup consultation form for planning a look, and send tattoo clients a tattoo consent form for the procedure they are agreeing to. Keep each form short, with only the questions that apply to that service.

faq_plan.q: When should a client fill out a makeup consultation form?
faq_plan.a: At booking, well before the appointment. For a wedding, ask for it when the client books the trial. The artist then has the answers in hand for the trial itself. For a group booking, set a date for the last answers and remind anyone who has not replied. The app can send those reminders by email.

faq_plan.q: Should a makeup consultation form be online or on paper?
faq_plan.a: Online, if you want the answers before the client arrives. A makeup consultation form pdf has to be printed, filled in by hand, and brought along or scanned back. An online form saves every booking where you can search it. Emergent builds it with no response caps, however many bookings arrive.

faq_plan.q: What should stay off a makeup consultation form?
faq_plan.a: Leave off anything the artist does not need to plan the look. Questions about medical history for treatments such as injectables belong on their own paperwork, such as a botox consent form at a med spa, not on a makeup booking. Ask for a phone number and an email, and skip the home address unless you travel to the client.
